The walkthrough is published, and the continuous pricing is built and waiting on one confirmation from you.

**Review the whole flow**
- https://eugenechantk.me/pages/belly-branch-walkthrough-every-screen-answered-5038ce9b/ (Artifact: https://claude.ai/code/artifact/51e781fa-63ca-4cd8-8c5a-356d1a856420)

All 31 screens from one real pass, answered as Margaret: 165 cm, 82 kg wanting 72 kg at a moderate pace before a December holiday, sleeping badly, flagging by mid-afternoon, a bad back. Every interstitial, readout, chart and the paywall are built from those answers, grouped by act with the pick noted under each screen. Two screens in there are the other session's current work, not mine: the trajectory screen now titled "Your plan for the middle", and the date field that replaced my month tiles.

**Pricing for the branch, built**
- Two continuous plans on a new `belly` ladder: month by month at $19.99, and three months at a time at $44.99 (about $15 a month), the three-month card default with the "Best value" band. Both renew until she cancels; no twelve-week purchase, no trial.
- The server decides from her stored goal answer, so a sitting on the branch always lands on this ladder, never the hashed arms. Fulfilment no longer schedules the twelve-week end on these plans; the catalogue script creates them as monthly prices.
- The paywall cards, band, checkout sheet promises and the "does it end after 12 weeks?" FAQ all say continuous. Plan, branch, checkout and fulfilment tests are green.

**What needs your call.** The two amounts are my proposal. Nothing exists in Stripe yet, so checkout on the branch cannot open a session until the prices are created. Confirm the numbers, or give me yours, and I'll run the catalogue sync to create them. The live Stripe test will go green at that point.

**Also open:** the belly-branch paywall keeps the first-payment guarantee wording; the rest of the paywall order is as you set it.

---
**Summary:** Continuous monthly and 3-month pricing built for the belly branch (Stripe prices pending your amounts); full walkthrough captured and published.
**Actions:**
- Added the `belly` plan ladder, sitting detection, checkout routing, fulfilment exemption and catalogue support, with tests
- Wired the ladder into the paywall (cards, band, CTA, FAQ, sheet promises) and the branch's runtime apply
- Walked all 31 screens with realistic answers, built and published the review page

- Edited: `web/src/lib/plans.ts`, `web/src/lib/plans.test.ts`, `web/src/lib/pricing-experiment.ts`, `web/src/app/api/checkout/route.ts`, `web/src/lib/fulfil.ts`, `web/scripts/sync-stripe-catalog.ts`, `web/static-src/quiz/index.html`, `web/src/static-pages/quiz.ts`, `web/static-src/quiz/i18n/zh-TW.json`, `web/static-src/quiz-zh-tw/index.html`, `web/src/static-pages/quiz-zh-tw.ts`, `.claude/feature/quiz-belly-branch.md`

This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   - Original: propose a weight-loss/menopause-belly quiz rundown modelled on BetterMe; then build it as a branch of the live quiz ("build out the branch and then we can iterate on it together").
   - Iterations directed by Eugene (all implemented): branch starts after the goal question (no separate goal screen); Act order Your middle → Your numbers (height, weight w/ live BMI, goal weight, 032-style profile) → How you move (s2-1, s2-5, s2-6, sleep copy s2-w5, s2-10, energy reveal s2-w6) → What's in the way (s4-w1/s4-w2 statements, s4-1, with/without chart s4-w3) → Pace and goal (s4-w4..s4-w8) → name/email/processing → price page s5-7 only (s5-5/s5-6 skipped). Avatars: Roxie boards via GPT Image 2 on Higgsfield, cut to tiles with backgrounds removed, used on s1-w1, s1-w2, s2-w4, s2-w6 (list without containers, avatar 1.65× list height, legs below, no descriptions), paywall pair (two tinted columns with pills, body shape row, single zoomed animated BMI meter, figures cropped mid-thigh at 1.75×). Paywall: big "{Name}, your plan is ready" above chart, small "…built based on your body profile" above profile, "{Name}, get visible results in 4 weeks" above plans; chart week 4/12/end marks with label lift; no disclaimer; quiet profile section; "Progressive workout program"; 4th point without "15 minutes, three days a week"; weight/shape testimonials; per-arm price FAQ without 12-week wording; last FAQ removed; s4-w8 bubble shows typed goal weight.
   - Pricing: continuous programme; two experiment arms for the belly branch — monthly and "3 month" (later phrased "12 week") — each with free-trial default, "use the same pricing as we have with the original paywall" (trial $0→$19.99/mo or $14.99/mo pay today; trial $0→$59 or $49 pay today for the longer period).
   - Latest (current branch of the session): "because of the new belly loss continuous program, we need to create new stripe products for monthly subscription and 12 week subscription plan / and also wire in posthog tracking / can you do that for dev and staging first?"

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Static single-file quiz `web/static-src/quiz/index.html` → `pnpm sync-static-pages` → `src/static-pages/quiz.ts`; zh-TW port requires `pnpm quiz-locale extract zh-TW` → fill `static-src/quiz/i18n/zh-TW.json` (code fragments/units as "-") → `pnpm quiz-locale build zh-TW` → sync; locale test fails on any English 3+ letter word in zh text nodes (avoid BMI/App/HRT; "划" flagged as simplified).
   - Branch mechanism: goal-gated skips over one `screens` array (`FSBelly.skips`, `WEIGHT_SKIPS`, `BRANCH_ID=/^s\d-w\d/`), ids keep `s<act>-` prefix, `completeQuiz()` fired from s5-7 in branch, runtime paywall composition (hidden pair/testimonials restored in control), `data-fschoice` sanitised analytics, `data-fsval` numeric recording, `?belly=0` forces control.
   - Pricing architecture: `src/lib/plans.ts` ladders keyed by `PricingVariant`; `pricing-experiment.ts` FNV-1a hash mirrored on page (`fsVariantForId`, `fsBellyVariantForId`); checkout route recomputes variant server-side; `fulfil.ts` `endWhenTheProgrammeDoes` sets `cancel_at` (skipped for continuous plans via `renewsEveryMonths`); `scripts/sync-stripe-catalog.ts` creates products/prices by lookupKey from `ALL_PLANS`, loads `.env.local`, refuses live unless `FS_ALLOW_LIVE=1`; `plans.stripe.test.ts` (`pnpm test:stripe`) checks live Stripe amounts.
   - Analytics: PostHog via `/fs-analytics.js` (`FSPH.capture/once/register`), redactor blocks keys answer/answers/scores/profile; server `src/analytics/purchase.ts` stamps `pricing_variant`, `pricing_experiment`, `$feature/<experiment>`; Meta pixel never gets body data.
   - Environments: `.env.local` (dev) and `.env.staging` share one Stripe TEST key; PostHog keys differ per env (dev phc_ozyR…, staging phc_mqdm…, prod phc_v4ou…); `.env.prod` live Stripe key; Vercel Preview/Production envs.
   - Tools: gstack `browse` headless Chromium (dev server localhost:3100, `?dev=1` HUD; screenshots under /private/tmp or web/), Higgsfield CLI (gpt_image_2, 8.5 credits/board), rembg (u2net_human_seg), posthog-cli api (agent help loaded; tools experiment-create, create-feature-flag, project-get, projects-get, switch-project), verification-auditor subagent.
   - Concurrent session editing the same tree (brand rename FiftyStrong/50Queen, trajectory screen restyle, s4-w7 native date field, milestoneChart, easedShare in belly-math) — use exact-anchor edits, expect `quiz-experiments`/`plans.stripe` failures from their work.

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - `web/src/lib/plans.ts` — `PlanId` adds `"monthly" | "quarterly"`; `Plan.renewsEveryMonths?: 1 | 3`; `BELLY_MONTHLY_PLANS` (monthly `fiftystrong_belly_m1499_month` $14.99; trial `fiftystrong_belly_m1999_month_t7` $19.99 default, trialDays 7) and `BELLY_QUARTERLY_PLANS` (quarterly `fiftystrong_belly_q49_3month` $49; trial `fiftystrong_belly_q59_3month_t7` $59 default); `PLAN_LADDERS.belly_monthly/belly_quarterly`; `ALL_PLANS` includes both. Eugene now says "12 week subscription" → planned change to a 12-week recurring interval.
   - `web/src/lib/pricing-experiment.ts` — `PricingVariant` adds `belly_monthly|belly_quarterly`; `BELLY_EXPERIMENT = "belly_sep04_monthly_vs_quarterly"`; `bellyVariantForId(id)` (null → belly_quarterly; hash bit → belly_monthly/belly_quarterly).
   - `web/src/lib/belly-branch.ts` (+ test) — `isBellySitting(answers)`: `s1-4[0]` is "0" or starts with "lose weight".
   - `web/src/app/api/checkout/route.ts` — fetches sitting when `!returning?.stripeCustomerId && quizPublicId`; `pricingVariant = returning ? "control" : isBellySitting(sitting?.answers) ? bellyVariantForId(quizPublicId) : variantForId(quizPublicId)`; `quizEmail = sitting?.email ?? null`.
   - `web/src/lib/fulfil.ts` — in `endWhenTheProgrammeDoes`: `const key = subscription.items?.data?.[0]?.price?.lookup_key ?? null; if (key && planForLookupKey(key)?.renewsEveryMonths) return subscription;`
   - `web/scripts/sync-stripe-catalog.ts` — `recurringFor`: `if (plan.renewsEveryMonths) return { interval: "month", interval_count: plan.renewsEveryMonths };`
   - `web/src/lib/plans.test.ts` — belly blocks: `describe.each([["belly_monthly", BELLY_MONTHLY_PLANS, "monthly", 1, [1499,1999]], ["belly_quarterly", BELLY_QUARTERLY_PLANS, "quarterly", 3, [4900,5900]]])`, split test for `bellyVariantForId` (83 tests pass).
   - `web/src/analytics/purchase.ts` — stamps `pricing_experiment: PRICING_EXPERIMENT` and `[$feature/${PRICING_EXPERIMENT}]: pricingVariant`; needs a belly-experiment twin for belly arms (pending).
   - `web/static-src/quiz/index.html` — head: `window.fsBellyVariantForId` mirror; `LADDERS.belly_monthly` / `LADDERS.belly_quarterly` (band 'Try 7 days for free', defaultPlan 'trial', `slots {twelve_week:'monthly'|'quarterly', four_weekly: same}`, `titles`, `ctaFor`, per-arm `faq`, plans with trial after/afterUnit); `function applyLadder(L)` (handles `slots`/`titles`), `applyLadder(LADDERS[variant])`, `window.FSAB_APPLY`; `PROMISES.monthly/quarterly`; FSBelly `renderPaywall`: applies hashed arm once (`card.dataset.bellyLadder`), registers `pricing_variant`/`pricing_experiment`, hides `after-12-weeks` FAQ, rewrites 4th checklist point, testimonials, profile section (`profileSection()`), `.fsb-*` prefixed pair block with zoomed animated meter, `milestoneChart` label lift and Week 12 mark, chart title `h1 fsb-h1` with name, s4-w8 bubble shows `fmtKg(g)`.
   - `web/public/quiz/img/shape/{now-middle,now-allover,now-hips,now-straight,after-thin,after-toned,after-curvy,after-smaller}.webp` — alpha cutouts.
   - `.claude/feature/quiz-belly-branch.md` — feature doc with SC1–SC11, evidence, audit PASS, decision log, pricing notes (Stripe prices pending).
   - `.claude/quiz-belly/` — proposal.md, build_proposal.py, build_refs.py, build_flow_review.py, figures/, flow-review/.
   - `.claude/evidence/quiz-belly-branch/` — walkthrough, audit, visual-profile.

4. Errors and fixes:
   - Pinned tests: `if (screens[i].id === 's5-5') {` literal and `data-fssection="testimonials"` count → factored `completeQuiz()`, built selectors by concatenation.
   - Hidden inches field visible (`.namefield{display:block}` beat `[hidden]`) → CSS rule.
   - Chart axis labels clipped → wider margin, rounded labels; overlapping date labels → skip date when marks < 92px apart; weight labels lifted when marks < 72px apart.
   - Unit toggle drift (71→71.2) → toggle re-displays canonical value.
   - Class collisions (`.bachev`, `.bahd`, `.baf`) with page's own CSS; a global rename clobbered the page's classes → reverted outside my regions, prefixed mine `fsb-`.
   - Shared SVG gradient id blanked the meter on s2-w6 → per-screen ids.
   - zh-TW locale test failures → translated keys, avoided "App"/"BMI"/"HRT"/"划".
   - Patch anchors failing because the other session changed code (e.g. `milestoneChart`, `renderPaywall` header, s4-w7 date field) → re-read and re-anchored; walkthrough script adapted to fill `[data-date]`.
   - cwd drift in Bash (`cd ..` earlier) → always `cd web` first.
   - Slug-file collision for two Cloudflare pages in one folder → separate `proposal-page/` and `refs-page/`.
   - Eugene feedback: he wanted the BetterMe mechanics included with guardrails rather than omitted; wanted "3 months"/"12 week" plans and trial defaults; wanted avatars bigger, containers removed, etc.

5. Problem Solving:
   - Full branch built, self-verified, auditor PASS, visual verifier PASS. Pricing model for continuous belly arms implemented server+page; Stripe prices not yet created (awaiting confirmation; now explicitly requested for dev/staging). Ongoing: concurrent session edits the same files; full `pnpm test` failures on brand-arm and live-Stripe tests are theirs/pending sync.
